programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the National Finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the all important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Hes showcasing British Rose veal and celebrating the determination of British producers to bounce back from disaster.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the final chance for three of London and South Easts most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as Guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award winning food writer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the North East Regional title but hes competing against two young newcomers Tommy Banks and Chris Archer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs from the North East, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the main course of the North East Region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. Its a tough and emotional day for the chefs.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own Great Briton, his late Grandfather.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for the judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Joining them is guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive Head Chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three top chefs from Northern Ireland are competing for a place in the National Finals. There are some varied and exciting starters, as the chefs get creative. And theres real shock and emotion as the veteran chef delivers his scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more competitive as the three chefs from Northern Ireland dish cook their fish courses.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for an historic score, he could beat his boss a veteran of GBM and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the National Finals of Great British Menu. The chefs will mark each course of the fellow chefs dishes; the average of their scores will be added to the judges scores. There are some shocks and surprises as the chefs opinions differ from the judges.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is day two of Great British Menus National Finals. Today the eight champions will cook their fish courses. Two chefs have reason to be confident after scoring tens from every judge in the heats. Can they deliver a perfect dish second time round?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the National Finals of Great British Menu and main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. It is a nerve wracking day for three of the eight regional champions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the final day of the competition in this years Great British Menu, this is the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth lls Great Britons.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Great British Menus winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. As the banquet is served the chefs show just why they are amongst the best in the country.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week its the heats for the North East region, and today the chefs are cooking their starters.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After a tense Starter coursesthe chefs are all aimingfor 10s with their unique fish dishes.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: As the chefs approach the halfway point of their regional heat, the pressure is mounting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the chefs last chance to impress and tensions are high.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two remaining North East chefs must cook their four course menus again.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week it's the turn of three chefs from London and the South East.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs do battle for the fish course, they all strive for perfection the atmosphere in the kitchen is tense

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs prepare their celebratory mains in the hope of impressing the veteran judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.desc: Sierra Nevada Jones must fight a villainous rancher to regain the land that is rightfully hers.

programme.title: God Is My Colt

programme.title: Taste of Killing
programme.desc: Dubious Bounty Killer Hank Fellows tracks bank stage coaches to observe them being robbed.

programme.title: To Hell and Back
programme.desc: Johnny King, a rebellious drifter, sets out to avenge the death of his mentor and friend, Steve, after he has been murdered for his land by the Ward Brothers.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
programme.desc: Sartana, a bounty hunter and gunfighter, witnesses a gold robbery and arrives in a suspicious town run by Samuel Spencer. Hired to protect the next shipment, Sartana fends off numerous incompetent villains, surviving their attempts on his life. Meanwhile, his nemesis, Sabbath—known for his white coat and parasol—arrives in town. With tensions rising, Sartana and Sabbath are headed for a final showdown to settle the score.

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican
programme.desc: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

programme.title: Ride Out for Revenge
programme.desc: When an Indian chief is murdered in a hateful town, a sympathizing ex marshal tries to stop the Indians from attacking for revenge.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: A disgraced Confederate colonel deserts and escapes into the Everglades, joining four other Southern deserters. Surrounded by hostile Seminoles, the group must navigate the treacherous swamp while confronting both nature and their inner demons in a tense fight for survival.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak. Our black-clad hero soon has a price on his head and must try to proof his innocence with the help of his shabby friend Buddy Ben.

programme.title: The Cariboo Trail
programme.desc: Montanans Jim Redfern and Mike Evans head into Canada's British Columbia via the Cariboo Trail intent to raise cattle and dig for gold but find trouble instead.

programme.title: His Name Was Sam Walbash, But They Call Him Amen
programme.desc: A cruel and ruthless bandit kills a tavern owner who had ratted him out to the authorities.

programme.title: The Avenging Angel
programme.desc: Miles Utley, a skilled Mormon commando and bodyguard, is forced to go rogue while investigating a deadly scandal of assassination and land speculation. As danger mounts, he must confront his beliefs and decide where his true loyalties lie in a world of betrayal and faith.

programme.title: Dead Men Don't Count
programme.desc: Two gunmen ride into a town with a plan to collect a large unearned bounty but are caught up in the local war for land caused by the impending arrival of the railroad.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Gang of sadistic cowboys let nothing stand in their way in their search for gold.

programme.title: Four Fast Guns
programme.desc: A gunslinger rides into Purgatory, claiming to be the town tamer they hired—though he killed the real one. For $500, payable to a widow of his victim, he takes on the town's wheelchair-bound crime boss. The outlaw fights to free the town while facing three hired killers sent to eliminate him, testing his resolve and his skill as lawman-for-hire.

programme.title: The Shakiest Gun in the West
programme.desc: A pardoned stagecoach robber, becomes government agent and marries a naive unsuspecting east-coast dentist in order to join a wagon train.

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

programme.title: Apache Gold
programme.desc: Construction of the Great Western Railroad sparks conflict with neighboring Native American tribes. Gang leader Santer manipulates the rail route through sacred Apache land to seize a hidden gold mine. Surveyor Old Shatterhand uncovers the plot and seeks out the Apaches in a desperate effort to prevent war.

programme.title: Thunder at the Border
programme.desc: Winnetou and his sister Nscho-chi flee the murderous Silers gang and find refuge with Old Firehand and his trappers. In the border town of Miramonte, an old love and family secret are revealed, but the reunion is threatened when the Silers gang prepares an attack. Winnetou and Old Firehand help defend the town.

programme.title: Gunman of One Hundred Crosses
programme.desc: An Irishman is killed in the wild West. His son Jimmy goes out searching for the killers of his father, but is soon ambushed by two highwaymen, and killed, too.

programme.title: Boot Hill
programme.desc: Victims of oppressive town boss Honey are offered help by an unusual alliance of gunmen and circus performers.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: The eldest daughter of a pioneer family is kidnapped by a mysterious Indian tribe and the eldest son pursues. In order to win back his sister's freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of Crooked Sky and shield his sister from an executioner's arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.title: Bandidos
programme.desc: Renowned gunman Richard Martin is traveling on a train, held up by Billy Kane, a former student of Martin's. Kane spares Martin, but only after shooting his hands. Years later, Martin meets an escaped convict, wrongly convicted for the train robbery. Martin trains his new student and both men seek out Billy Kane.

programme.title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil
programme.desc: Scotty is hired to eliminate a gang of Mexican bandits led by El Condor. He cleverly earns their trust to trap them—but as he bonds with El Condor, a true friendship and mutual respect begin to challenge his mission.

programme.title: Singing Guns
programme.desc: Notorious stagecoach robber Rhiannon is unintentionally appointed as deputy when he saves the sheriff's life and must wear two hats between his new job that he enjoys and his old occupation that he misses.

programme.desc: Arms trafficking with the Indians on the one hand and acquiring documents concerning the ownership of a goldmine on the other are the principal interests of Quin and Gomez, the highly suspicious guests at Papa Martinez' inn.

programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Dion gives a referee a red card for buying a house in Bulwell in Nottinghamshire without viewing it before the auction while Lucy meets a man who has bought a studio flat in South Norwood in London with a family consortium.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A former bothy in Fife, an end terrace in Nottinghamshire and a semi in Feltham near Heathrow airport are sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A flat with a sea view in Helensburgh in Scotland, a lodge house in West Bridgford in Nottinghamshire and a chalet bungalow in Callington in Cornwall are all sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A former pub in Folkestone, a semi in Sutton Coldfield and a terrace in Telford are sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion travel to Kent, Birmingham and Shropshire to meet the new owners and hear their plans.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A house ripe for extending in New Haw in Surrey, a three bed semi calling out for a fourth bedroom in Langwith on the Nottinghamshire Derbyshire boarder and a former school site in Wales are all sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A two bedroom flat in a period house in Walthamstow in London, a former health centre in Mansfield in Nottinghamshire and a terraced house in Heanor in Derbyshire are all sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A chalet bungalow on the Notts Derbyshire boarder, a terraced house in Reigate in Surrey and a bungalow with a view in Braystones in Cumbria are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Its a family affair with a trio of father and son developers, bidding on auction buys in Dover, Wolverhampton and Londons Wandsworth. Martin, Lucy and Dion talk to the dads and their sons to hear what their plans are to make money.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A semi in St Austell in Cornwall, a mid-terrace in Croydon and a former hotel in Southampton are sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners to hear their ambitious plans to make money from their investments.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: An end terrace in Walsall in the West Midlands, a basement flat in Tunbridge Wells and a bungalow in Hinkley in Leicestershire are bought under the hammer by developers hoping to make some money.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin meets a young family with a toddler and a newborn who buy a house near Stoke on Trent to live in. Dion and Lucy talk to developers who have bought a terraced house in Darwen in Lancashire and a maisonette in Londons Plumstead.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners of a quaint terraced cottage in Clent in Worcestershire, a terraced house in South Croydon, and a big house in Edgbaston and follow the progress of the investors hoping to make money from their auction buys.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A grand Edwardian home in Eltham in London, a piece of land near Birmingham and a property in Newcastle-under-Lyme all go under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear their plans.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin meets a couple wanting to transform a rundown house into a forever home, Dion talks to two friends embarking on their first property adventure while Lucy meets a seasoned property developer and his son who have a three phase plan.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A former bank in Crewe is sold at auction, but will it prove a nice little earner for its new owner? In Cumbria a flood damaged home is bought to benefit the community, and in London a developer has grand plans for a two bedroom flat in Tooting.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin is on the North Wales coast, Dion is in Derby and Lucys in Maidstone, Kent. The developers are considering adding bedrooms and putting in new bathrooms and kitchens, but will splashing the cash net them more money?

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A super dad helps his daughter out buying and transforming a maisonette for her to live in, and in Derby two friends hope to create smart accommodation for seven students. In Rainham in Kent a developer has ambitious plans to smarten up a shop.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A film extra buys a flat to refurbish in Folkestone in Kent, while another developer has ambitious plans for a former council depot in Milton in Stoke on Trent and two footballing friends take on a detached 1930s house in Norbury in London.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Two brothers buy a bungalow for their mother in Staffordshire and elsewhere property developers buy a huge barn in Upwell in Norfolk and a large three bedroom flat in Londons Tooting.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: There's a plan to transform a Victorian terrace in York into a home, while developers in Rainham, Kent, want to build flats on land sandwiched between two busy roads and investors hope to restore a flood damaged Cumbrian property.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A damp and dingy basement flat in Kilburn with space for an extension, a former post office in Gedney Dyke in Lincolnshire and a bungalow in Cornwalls Liskeard are sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A large listed Georgian house in Faversham is given the wow factor and developers in Witham St Annes in Lancashire and New Southgate in London also deliver top notch finishes on their very different flats. Martin, Lucy and Dion follow their progress.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Lucy is in Catford to follow progress on a one bedroom flat its new owners hope to turn into a two bed. Dion is in Wigton looking at a house with a flying freehold and Martin is in a large end of terraced house in Blackpool.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Lucy talks to a developer with ambitious plans for a three bed semi in Croydon, Martin looks round another semi in Derbys Alvaston and Dion follows progress of a house damaged by the 2015 Cumbrian floods as it's restored to its former glory.

programme.desc: Todays properties include a Norfolk new build and a Maidstone project with a distant outdoor loo.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: Nuoripari matkustaa syrjäiselle mökille selvittelemään suhdettaan. Sitten mökille ilmestyy yllätysvieras; tuntematon mies pahat mielessä. Matkasta tulee oikea painajainen, ja nuoret joutuvat kamppailemaan hengestään.

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Nuori Therese Belivet (Rooney Mara) työskentelee tavaratalossa 1950-luvun alun Manhattanilla ja unelmoi täydemmästä elämästä. Hän tapaa Carol Airdin (Cate Blanchett), viehättävän kypsän naisen, joka on loukussa murenevassa kulissiavioliitossa.

programme.title: Paluu Yorkshireen
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison (Jim Broadbent) saa tietää, että hänellä on syöpä ja vain muutama viikko aikaa elää. Hänen vanhin poikansa Blake (Oscar-voittaja* Colin Firth) muuttaa Yorkshireen äitinsä luokse, kylään jossa hän syntyi. Kun Arthurin tila heikkenee, Blake puntaroi suhdettaan isäänsä.

programme.title: I, Daniel Blake
programme.desc: 59-vuotias Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) on työskennellyt suurimman osan elämästään puuseppänä Newcastlessa. Sydänkohtauksen ja työtapaturman suistettua hänen elämänsä raiteiltaan hän saa huomata, ettei yhteiskunnan turvaverkko kannattelekaan kaikkia.

programme.title: Majava
programme.desc: Majavasta voi olla apua sinullekin! Walter Blackin huumori on yhtä mustaa kuin hänen sukunimensä. Töissä menee huonosti, vaimo on saanut tarpeekseen ja poika vihaa isäänsä.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: Happy-Go-Lucky
programme.desc: Opettaja Poppy selviytyy optimisminsa turvin elämän pienistä vastoinkäymisistä ja levittää ympärilleen iloa ja naurua.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming To Christmas Dinner?
programme.desc: Aktiivinen, liberaali ja edistyksellinen oikeustieteen opiskelija Maya tuo uuden poikaystävänsä kotiin jouluksi - kertomatta perheelleen, että hän on valkoinen. Arvaa, kuka tulee joulupäivälliselle?

programme.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva komedia mallikansalaisesta Steven Russellista, jonka radikaalilla elämänmuutoksella on hintansa. Patologisen valehtelijan munaukset vievät miehen suoraan kaapista häkkiin, kun hän jää luksuselämänsä rahoittamiseen kehitetyistä superhuijauksista kiinni rysän päältä.

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: THEN CAME YOU kertoo kuolemansairaasta teinistä Skyesta (Maisie Williams) ja luulosairaasta 19-vuotiaasta Calvinista (Asa Butterfield), joka pelkää omaa varjoaankin.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Tositarina irlantilaisesta hävittäjälentäjä Brendan ”Paddy” Finucanesta, josta vain 21-vuotiaana tuli Royal Air Forcen nuorin laivueenkomentaja ja yksi toisen maailmansodan suurimmista ja palkituimmista hävittäjä-ässistä.

programme.title: Bullet To The Head
programme.desc: Yksi elokuvahistorian suurimmista toimintasankareista on taas täällä: Sylvester Stallone esittää kivikovaa, New Orleansissa asuvaa palkkamurhaajaa.

programme.title: Ranskalaisen luutnantin nainen (The French Lieutenant's Woman)
programme.desc: Tässä viisi Oscar-ehdokkuutta (muun muassa parhaan naisnäyttelijän, Meryl Streep) ansainneessa, koskettavan kauniissa mestariteoksessa näyttelee myös Jeremy Irons. Elokuva on yksi visuaalisesti ja emotionaalisesti upeimmista rakkaustarinoista.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Ben Aronoffin tositarina. Hän on maailman nopeimpien veneiden luoja ja suihkuseurapiireissä viihtyvä mies, jolla on säteilevä hymy ja rahaa kuin roskaa.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Newyorkilainen työhullu kustannustoimittaja Jackie seuraa poikaansa Los Angelesiin. Poika haluaa jättää opiskelut sikseen ja elää unelmaansa Kaliforniassa, missä myös äidillä on pian edessään tyrskyjä ja kuohuja.

programme.title: Paluu Yorkshireen
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison (Jim Broadbent) saa tietää, että hänellä on syöpä ja vain muutama viikko aikaa elää. programme.title: You're Not You
programme.desc: Kaksinkertainen Oscar-voittaja Hillary Swank on menestynyt konserttipianisti Kate, jossa todetaan parantumaton sairaus ALS. Hänen perheensä järjestää hänelle parasta mahdollista hoitoa, mutta Kate itse antautuu täysin epäpätevän Becin hoiviin.
Nuoren kirjailijan on hyväksyttävä kuolevaisuutensa kun hänellä todetaan harvinainen syöpä.Parhaan ystävänsä ja empaattisen nuoren terapeutin avulla hän löytää rohkeuden taistella sairautta vastaan.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: Slevin joutuu vahingossa keskelle New Yorkin pahimpien rikollispomojen Rabbin ja Bossin veristä sotaa. Slevinin kannoilla pyörivät lisäksi sinnikäs poliisi Brikowski ja pahamaineinen tappaja Goodkat. Hänen on keksittävä viheliäinen juoni päästäkseen heistä ennen kuin on itse mennyttä.

programme.title: Colossal

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: Nuoripari matkustaa syrjäiselle mökille selvittelemään suhdettaan. Sitten mökille ilmestyy yllätysvieras; tuntematon mies pahat mielessä. Matkasta tulee oikea painajainen, ja nuoret joutuvat kamppailemaan hengestään.

programme.title: Manhattan
programme.desc: Tässä modernissa klassikossa Isaacilla (Woody Allen) on liian nuori tyttöystävä ja ex-vaimo, joka on laatimassa paljastustarinaa heidän elämästään. Mutta tavatessaan Maryn (Diane Keaton) alkaa hänen täyttymyksen etsintänsä rakkaalla Manhattanillaan.

programme.title: High Noon In L.A.

programme.title: True Confessions

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino on epäonnistunut kirjailija, josta tuli tiskaaja. Nyt hänet tunnetaan ex-vaimon pitämästä blogista “Miksi olet paska”, josta on tullut suuri hitti. Sitten Leo tapaa Coletten, unelmiensa naisen… päivänä, jona Colette on menossa naimisiin täydellisen miehen kanssa.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Tervetuloa Westburgin lukioon jossa halitsee kolme kauneuskuningatarta, Heather C, Heather M ja Heather D. Heillä on valta, ulkonäkö ja rahat tehdäkseen mitä he haluavat.

programme.title: Amateur Night
programme.desc: Jason Biggs esittää Guyta, palkittua, vasta valmistunutta arkkitehtia. Nyt hän on kuitenkin työtön, tuleva isä, joka etsii epätoivoisesti töitä. Vaimonsa vaatimuksesta Guy vastaa netti-ilmoitukseen, jossa etsitään ”kuljettajaa”.

programme.title: Madness in the Method
programme.desc: Jason Mewes ei halua olla vain Jay and Silent Bobin Jay. Hän ottaa avukseen elokuvantekijä Kevin Smithin jäljittääkseen kirjan, joka voisi tehdä hänestä vakavan ja kunnioitetun näyttelijän. Sitä hän ei kuitenkaan tajua ottaa huomioon...

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Kun lähetti toimittaa vahingossa kätkettyjä kokaiinitiiliä sisältävän paketin väärään osoitteeseen, hän käynnistää tapahtumasarjan...

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards on onneton nuori mies, joka kärsii vastakaiuttomasta rakkaudesta ja haluaa epätoivoisesti muuttaa elämänsä. Hän solmii sopimuksen paholaisen kanssa, ja tämä lupaa toteuttaa hänen toiveensa – mutta sillä on hintansa.

programme.title: Courageous Avenger
programme.desc: Gold, gangs, and the heroic fight for life! Johnny Mack Brown (Billy the Kid, Coquette) stars in this western thriller about murders going on in a mining community. Its a story full of twists, where the greed for gold is only surpassed by the struggle for life!

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. He's assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and learn about the emir's activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho protect a man being chased by outlaws who believe he is responsible for a gold robbery. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho break a woman out of prison before she is hanged for murder.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog.. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: A town blames the son-in-law of a the bank president for his murder. Cisco and Pancho work to uncover the truth before the townspeople hang the man. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: After arriving in the town of Sundance, Cisco witnesses the destruction of a newspaper office. Upon seeing this, Cisco contends with the man trying to take over the town. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie face off with a murdering desperado who has been terrorizing the northwest. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Also starring Steve Brodie, RIchard Avonde, Helen Wallace, Gene Roth, and Edward Clark. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954 .Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Matt and Frankie meet the Wild Bunch and their jovial leader Butch Cassidy.Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Also starring Joe Sawyer, Slim Pickens, Lane Chandler, and Bob Carney. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as Matt Clark, a railroad detective who is investigating a railroad holdup. Starring Mary Castle. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955. (This episode also features James Best (1926-2015), who would go on to appear on such shows as The Andy Griffith Show, Bonanza, and The Dukes of Hazzard.)

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark discovers the hideout of the famous Doolin gang. Clark, along with Detective Frankie, work to infiltrate the hideout and bring the Doolin gang to justice.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Directed by William Witney. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle, along with Leo Gordon, Joan Shawlee, Don Kennedy, Kenneth MacDoNald, Patrick Waltz, and Ken Chryson. First aired in 1954.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After shooting Luke Grayson in self-defense, Ben Cartwright must protect himself from Graysons son, Todd, who seeks to avenge his fathers death.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Cartwrights try to invalidate a Spanish land grant to stop the De La Cuesta family from taking part of the Ponderosa and all of the Carson Valley settlers' land.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Adam Cartwright finds himself hostage to Jeb, a dangerous sheep herder who wants Ben to sign over a large plot of land.Starring Michael Landon as Little Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben helps three deserters, escaped from an Army stockade. Learning what they had to deal with, Ben promises to share the truth with his friend who is in charge of the fort.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: In Old Cheyenne
programme.desc: Roy Rogers plays a newspaper reporter sent to Cheyenne to investigate a reputed troublemaker. While on the scene, he discovers who the real bad guys are, and sets out to right some wrongs. Also starring Roy's usual sidekick George 'Gabby' Hayes, plus Joan Woodbury, and George Rosener. This Republic Pictures western was helmed by director Joseph Kane (The Undersea Kingdom, Dakota) and features two musical numbers: 'Bonita' and 'Linda Flor'.

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: His Wits, Weapons and Women, Turned Defeat Into Victory! A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives! Starring Lance Fuller, Sterling Holloway, Henry Hull, Chill Wills, Cathy Downs, and Jeanne Cagney, plus one of the great B-Western heels, I. Stanford Jolley!

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: Oscar winner Michael Curtiz (Casablanca, Mildred Pierce) directed this exciting drama about Army officer Jeb Stuart and the days leading up to the Civil War. Errol Flynn (The Adventures of Robin Hood) stars as Stuart, with Olivia de Havilland as his romantic interest (the seventh of nine times they were paired together by Warner Bros.) The cast includes Ronald Reagan as General George Custer, and Raymond Massey as John Brown, with such familiar faces as Alan Hale and Van Hefflin in supporting roles. Filmed partly in Santa Fe!

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco witnesses a dog identifying the murderer of his master. He then tries to prove that the dog is right. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

She visits iconic landmarks like the Duomo, Uffizi Gallery, and Ponte Vecchio, uncovering the city’s artistic legacy. Along the way, she enjoys Tuscan classics like Bistecca alla Fiorentina and the delicious schiaccata panino.

programme.title: BP Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal 2026
programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally-Raid joined the W2RC calendar in 2024. The competition on Portuguese and Spanish tracks is always unforgettable for both cars and motorcycles. The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. Diversity is the key word for the five days of racing! The bivouac is set up in the heart of the town of Grândola, in the province of Setúbal, 100 kilometers south of Lisbon.

programme.title: The Missing Chief Bridesmaid
programme.desc: Detective Lazarus battles life and work as he solves various crime puzzles - from a missing will tearing a family apart, an important package setting him on a wild goose chase, a missing chief bridesmaid days before a wedding and an expensive heirloom. But each case has twists and turns and shows not all is what it seems.

programme.title: Sent From Heaven
programme.desc: A young woman who is desperate for work believes her poor background is what is stopping her from progressing.

programme.title: Hurdles
programme.desc: An arrogant, fastidious and yet successful young lady eventually meets her match. To her dismay, he is unnerved by her attitude, flouts her rules and refuses to bend to her will, causing him to get under her skin.

programme.title: My Burden
programme.desc: The demise of a couple comes after their daughter gets kidnapped by a sex trafficking ring. They both have different ideas on what to do to bring her home successfully.

programme.title: Temptation
programme.desc: After losing his job and plunging his family into financial hardship, David grows suspicious when his wife increasingly finds solace in the church.

programme.title: Peas In A Pod
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. An older couple are seeking divorce after a case of infidelity, that happened many years ago, is revealed.

programme.title: The Will
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Benita's world is turned upside down when she finds out that she is the daughter of a wealthy businessman who recently died. She is invited to the reading of his will but his family make things very hostile for her.

programme.title: The Fourth Party
programme.desc: Sophie Williams, the pregnant daughter of a billionaire chief, is on the verge of being duped and killed in exchange for all her inheritance after trusting the wrong people.

programme.title: Forever Is A Lie
programme.desc: Jason and Ivy are a young couple and partners in love and in crime as they get money from commiting fraudulent activities against unsuspecting victims, however things start to go wrong when jealousy seeps in and one of them takes things too far.

programme.title: AMC Music Lounge S7 - Major AJ
programme.desc: AMC Music Lounge returns for its seventh season bringing you some new interviews, new live performances, fun musical games, and many more from legendary and emerging artistes.

programme.title: Love Over Riches
programme.desc: Pascal's outlook on life changes when he crosses path with a bling young woman. His work and relationship suffers and he is faced with the dilemma to choose between love or the luxury.

programme.title: In Bloom - Alta
programme.desc: A collection of 5 short films addressing gender equality issues such as period poverty, child marriage, gender-based violence, HIV and economic empowerment. Second Short: Alta, written and directed by Priyanka Banerjee (India). A defiant teenager refusing to come out of the bathroom forces her helpless father to seek help to reason with the girl, but things take a turn when their true relationship is revealed.

programme.title: The Half Sisters Ep20
programme.desc: A situational comedy following the lives of four half sisters who have the same father but different mothers separated along cultural and polygamous lines, and the failed effort of their father to make them bond, separate from their mothers’ petulant quarrels which they have now inherited.

programme.title: The Half Sisters Ep21
programme.desc: A situational comedy following the lives of four half sisters who have the same father but different mothers separated along cultural and polygamous lines, and the failed effort of their father to make them bond, separate from their mothers’ petulant quarrels which they have now inherited.

programme.title: My Kind Of Man
programme.desc: A woman, who saw her mother living under the thumb of her abusive father, struggles in her relationship as she wrestles with the concept of love, passion and abuse.

programme.title: Private Matters
programme.desc: When swinging couple, Angela and Michael, move into a new neighborhood, their promiscuous lifestyle becomes a sick charade and spins out of control.

programme.title: The Surrogate
programme.desc: In desperate need to have a child, a young couple decide to go down the route of having a surrogate, a decision that threatens their family and almost destroys their marriage.

programme.title: Enemy Within
programme.desc: When her son, Jerry, dies in a car accident, Mrs Briggs is quick to blame, Boma, her son's girlfriend who she disapproves of. She tries to get Osaze, her son's best friend and laywer to prosecute Boma, but time shows that the enemy is a little closer to home.

programme.title: More Than a Friend
programme.desc: Simeon struggles in his romantic relationships due to his close friendship with his so-called business partner, Amanda.

programme.title: Go Between
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Donnie and Rosana are going through rough times in their relationship due to work and social differences. They decide to seek counsel from a relationship expert, Dr. Elvina Jones, who decides to play mind games on the couple by giving them tasks that would jeopardize their relationship.

programme.title: Disaffection
programme.desc: Abigail spends her time looking down on her husband because he is poor, not realising that he is testing her love.

programme.title: Love In Odd Places
programme.desc: Jeff's life-changing illness has him in constant pain, causing him to transfer agression to those around him but true love comes to the rescue from the oddest place.

programme.title: Boss and I
programme.desc: A habitual womanizer finds love in his new employee, but his reputation threatens the stability of this relationship and his desired happiness.

programme.title: Cast On A Stone
programme.desc: Lisa’s life becomes a life lesson for an irresponsible father, after her criminal past catches up with her when her ex-boyfriend and current husband cross paths.

programme.title: Fashion Insider - Glam By Adu
programme.desc: Discover new designers, trends, styles, and more at Fashion Insider. Elileojo Achebo provides you with the opportunity to gain first-hand knowledge of the African stylists of the moment.

programme.title: Demands
programme.desc: The lives of two couples is forever entwined as they deal with lack of commitment, infidelity and unexpected pregnancies.

programme.title: The Half Sisters Ep22
programme.desc: A situational comedy following the lives of four half sisters who have the same father but different mothers separated along cultural and polygamous lines, and the failed effort of their father to make them bond, separate from their mothers’ petulant quarrels which they have now inherited.

programme.desc: A situational comedy following the lives of four half sisters who have the same father but different mothers separated along cultural and polygamous lines, and the failed effort of their father to make them bond, separate from their mothers’ petulant quarrels which they have now inherited.

programme.desc: A collection of 5 short films addressing gender equality issues such as period poverty, child marriage, gender-based violence, HIV and economic empowerment. programme.desc: You And I revolves around newlyweds, Ayo and Uzooma, as they face the most relatable challenges of marital life. Will love and commitment be enough to overcome the highs, lows, and everything in between?

programme.title: Lethal Obsession
programme.desc: Oma's relationship with her boss becomes increasingly complicated as a small crush develops into something far more deadly.

programme.desc: 11 years after his heart is broken by Mercy, Bryan runs into her when he comes back to Lagos after being abroad for his studies. programme.desc: Rikos ja rangaistus on moderni tulkinta Dostojevskin kuuluisasta romaanista. Murhaajan (Markku Toikka) ja poliisin (Esko Nikkari, Mies vailla menneisyyttä) huimaava psykologinen kaksintaistelu tapahtuu öisen Helsingin sivukujilla ja lain tuolla puolen.

programme.title: The Quiet Roar
programme.desc: Marianne (Evabritt Strandberg) on 68-vuotias nainen, jolla on parantumaton sairaus. Ahdistuneena hän hakeutuu terapiaan klinikalle, jossa häntä hoidetaan psilosybiinilla (LSD:llä) ja hoitaja Eva (Hanna Schygulla) johdattaa hänet meditaatioon.

programme.title: Boheemielämää
programme.desc: Boheemielämää kertoo kolmen taiteilijan tarinan. Kirjailija Marcel Marxin, taidemaalari Rodolfon ja säveltäjä Shaunardin, rakkauksien, töiden ja ainaisen rahapulan värittämään taiteilijaelämään pureutuva elokuva perustuu Henri Murgerin kuuluisaan samannimiseen romaaniin vuodelta 1851.

programme.title: Beyond Dreams
programme.desc: Mirja (Evin Ahmad) etsii paikkaansa maailmassa vankilasta päästyään. Saatuaan töitä hotellisiivoojana hän alkaa elää kaksoiselämää. Hänen sairas äitinsä ja vanhat ystävänsä, jotka ovat olleet hänen oikea perheensä, repivät häntä kahtaalle.

programme.title: JP ja Murtovaras
programme.desc: Sallikkalan kuntaa piinaa sarja murtovarkauksia, ja luvattomalle yöseikkailulle lähtenyt lapsikolmikko luulee nähneensä varkaan itse teossa! Nyt on perustettava salapoliisitoimisto ja ratkaistava juttu!

programme.title: Valehtelija
programme.desc: Valehtelija on kuvaus nuoresta huulenheittäjästä, joka ei koskaan puhu totta. Aki Kaurismäen esittämä nuori mies kuljeskelee pitkin Helsingin katuja ja koittaa lainata rahaa tutuilta ja tuntemattomilta, milloin milläkin verukkeella.

programme.title: Hella W
programme.desc: Sankarittaren elämä. Hella Wuolijoen elämä ja työ. Runoilija, vakooja ja miljonääri, josta tuli kansainvälisesti tunnettu liikenainen, poliitikko ja näytelmäkirjailija, joka teki yhteistyötä Euroopan johtavien kirjailijoiden, kuten Bertolt Brechtin ja Maksim Gorkin.

programme.title: Hamlet liikemaailmassa
programme.desc: Maailmankirjallisuuden tunnetuin sukudraama on siiretty nykysuomen liike-elämän vallan linnakkeisiin, keskelle Helsingin rock´n rollin tahdissa sykkivää betoniviidakkoa.

programme.title: Zombie ja kummitusjuna
programme.desc: Zombie on oman tiensä kulkija, joka ei pysty noudattamaan suomalaisen yhteiskunnan hänelle asettamia normeja. Zombie päättää jättää kaiken ja suunnata ulkomaille - paikkaan jossa kukaan ei odota häneltä mitään. Zombie ja kummitusjuna kuuluu monien mielestä Mika Kaurismäen elokuvien parhaimmistoon.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Akvaariorakkaus
programme.desc: Anna-Leena Härkösen menestysromaaniin perustuva elokuva itseään etsivästä Saarasta ja Jonista (Nicke Lignell), joka yrittää tehdä kaikkensa auttaakseen Saaraa, mutta tehtävä osoittautuu mahdottomaksi.

programme.title: Bieffekterna
programme.desc: Lääketieteen opiskelijat ja ohjelmoijat Julia ja Rebecca kuuluvat Lundin yliopiston eliittiryhmään, joka tutkii kiistanalaista tieteellistä menetelmää biohakkerointia, geenitekniikan uutta toivoa, joka saattaa merkitä tappavien sairauksien loppua.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 2
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: Juha
programme.desc: Juha (Sakari Kuosmanen, Kauas pilvet karkaavat) ja Marja (Kati Outinen, Sauna) elävät yhdessä onnellisina ja viattomina kuin lapset kunnes käärme luikertelee paratiisiin Shemeikan (André Wilms, Boheemielämää) hahmossa. Juha perustuu Juhani Ahon kuuluisaan romaaniin.

programme.title: Hamlet liikemaailmassa
programme.desc: Maailmankirjallisuuden tunnetuin sukudraama on siiretty nykysuomen liike-elämän vallan linnakkeisiin, keskelle Helsingin rock´n rollin tahdissa sykkivää betoniviidakkoa.

programme.title: Helsinki-Napoli All Night Long
programme.desc: Suomalainen Alex ajaa taksia Berliinin kolkoilla kaduilla. Ilta vaikuttaa alkavan kuten mikä tahansa muukin, vaimon heittäminen töihin, Igorin kanssa asioiden hoitelua, mutta sitten kyytiin hyppää kaksi hämärämiestä suuren rahalaukun kanssa, takaa-ajajat kintereillään!

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: Münsterin juttu
programme.desc: Varakas viininmaahantuoja löydetään brutaalisti murhattuna voimakkaan iskun jälkeen päähän. Münster saa tapauksen tutkittavakseen.

programme.title: I Hired a Contract Killer
programme.desc: Henri Boulanger (Jean-Pierre Léaud) seisoo vähäpätöisen virkansa menetettyään keskellä Lontoon miljoonakaupunkia ja huomaa, ettei hänellä ole ainoatakaan ystävää eikä sukulaista.

programme.title: Tulitikkutehtaan tyttö
programme.desc: Äitinsä ja isäpuolensa kanssa asuva ja tulitikkutehtaan liukuhihnalla työskentelevä Iiris (Kati Outinen, Mies vailla menneisyyttä ja Le Havre) erehtyy luulemaan tanssiravintolassa kohtaamansa miehen kanssa viettämäänsä yötä rakkaudeksi. Väärinkäsityksellä on kohtalokkaat seuraukset.

programme.title: JP ja Murtovaras
programme.desc: Sallikkalan kuntaa piinaa sarja murtovarkauksia, ja luvattomalle yöseikkailulle lähtenyt lapsikolmikko luulee nähneensä varkaan itse teossa! Nyt on perustettava salapoliisitoimisto ja ratkaistava juttu!

programme.title: Juha
programme.desc: Juha (Sakari Kuosmanen, Kauas pilvet karkaavat) ja Marja (Kati Outinen, Sauna) elävät yhdessä onnellisina ja viattomina kuin lapset kunnes käärme luikertelee paratiisiin Shemeikan (André Wilms, Boheemielämää) hahmossa. Juha perustuu Juhani Ahon kuuluisaan romaaniin.

programme.title: Winnerbäck
programme.desc: Lars Winnerbäck on lukeutunut Ruotsin suurimpiin artisteihin jo 15 vuotta, ja kuitenkin hän on se, josta tiedetään vähiten. Nyt tuskin 40 täyttänyt Winnerbäck viettää 20. taiteilijavuottaan.

programme.title: Viking Blood
programme.desc: Ryöstöretkellä ollessaan Tor-viikinki joutuu yllättäen keskelle vuosituhannen sotaa, jota käyvät vanhat ja uudet aasajumalat. Tor päättää, ettei yksikään heistä ansaitse voittoa ja valtaherruutta.

programme.title: Calamari Union
programme.desc: Calamari Union on kaikkien aikojen kulttiklassikko, joka kertoo seitsemäntoista Frankin ja yhden Pekan matkasta Kallion varjoisilta kujilta kohti Eiran raikkaita tuulia, joista he ovat kuulleet isovanhempiensa kertovan.

programme.title: Lindell - Orkesterimonttu - Osa 2
programme.desc: Elämänsä parhaan esityksen jälkeen oopperassa ensiviulisti Siv Ellen Blad murhataan julmasti. Rikoskomisario Cato Isaksen saa nopeasti selville, että hän oli joutunut postiryöstön kohteeksi. Piileekö siinä yhteys?

programme.title: Lindell - Hunajasyötti - Osa 1
programme.desc: On kesä. Elena Bukotaite - jäätelötehtaalla työskentelevä liettualaisnainen - ajetaan autolla kuoliaaksi. Samaan aikaan poliisi etsii 8-vuotiasta Høvikissä kadonnutta poikaa. Wiggo Nyman ajaa jäätelöautoa alueella. Hän oli myös Elenan miesystävä. Liittyvätkö tapaukset toisiinsa?

programme.desc: On kesä. Elena Bukotaite - jäätelötehtaalla työskentelevä liettualaisnainen - ajetaan autolla kuoliaaksi. Samaan aikaan poliisi etsii 8-vuotiasta Høvikissä kadonnutta poikaa. Wiggo Nyman ajaa jäätelöautoa alueella. Hän oli myös Elenan miesystävä. Liittyvätkö tapaukset toisiinsa?

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: The Leprechaun
programme.desc: Darrin reacts violently when he finds Brian O'Brian, a sprightly leprechaun, a guest in his home. Samantha tells him that Brian is not her relative but the leprechaun of Darrin's family. Brian reveals he has come to recover his pot of gold which was hidden in a fireplace brought to America by James Dennis Robinson. Darrin finds that Robinson owns a company whose account would be a great asset to Darrin's agency. Brian breaks into Robinson's house to retrieve the gold and is arrested. Darrin allows Samantha to use her magic to get Brian out of jail. Brian pleads with Samantha to help him recover his pot of gold which will restore his lost powers. Pledging Brian never to tell Darrin, Samantha returns with him to the Robinson's house. Robinson finds them in his study and reveals he has already removed the pot from the fireplace. Samantha is sur-prised when Robinson tells her he believes the leprechaun's story because his grandfather was a Mahoney, and returns Brian's pot of gold. Brian agrees to allow Robinson to use his picture as a trade mark if Robinson turns his advertising over to Darrin.

programme.title: The Lady In The Bottle
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: My Hero?
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: Jeannie And The Marriage Caper
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: G.I. Jeannie
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: The Yacht Murder Case
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: Anybody Here Seen Jeannie?
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: The Americanization Of Jeannie
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book How To Be A Woman. Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.
